consistency.notes: All three photos show the same white sleeveless fine-rib jersey top. The front has a high crew neck. The back is open, with two wide crossed straps. The side view confirms a high armhole, a side seam and a narrow hem. The V shape on the front is an inner layer showing through the sheer jersey.
